command: PYTHONPATH=<lane-h>/src .venv/bin/python -m pytest <lane-h>/tests -n auto --dist loadfile -m 'not stress and not timing' --ignore=<lane-h>/tests/review --ignore=<lane-h>/tests/runtime -q --durations=0 --tb=line
description: WP08 T041: measured --durations run on the post-scrub live basis (WP05). Per-test durations captured via an ad-hoc live-flushing pytest plugin (pytest_runtest_logreport, per-xdist-worker JSONL) so a killed/hung run still preserves whatever completed -- pytest's own --durations=0 report only prints at clean session end, which a hang never reaches. module_test_durations holds the actual per-test measured seconds (module attribution only -- nodeids dropped for compactness); shard_count in ci-module-registry.yml is chosen by greedy LPT (longest-processing-time-first) bin-packing of these durations so the WITHIN-module inter-shard skew stays <=20% (NFR-005).

excluded.reason: #3283 known bootstrap-hang dir (WP03-flagged). A follow-up bounded probe (tests/review + tests/runtime together, timeout=90s) reached ~95% collection progress before hanging (exit 124). Not run to completion in the main measurement pass.
#3283 known bootstrap-hang dir (WP03-flagged). Same bounded probe as tests/review above; both were run together and both are excluded from the main measurement pass for the same reason.

notes: One xdist worker (gw9) crashed on tests/retrospective/test_writer_atomicity.py::test_dir_fsync_failure_is_non_fatal (an fsync-failure-simulation test), surfacing as an xdist INTERNALERROR at session end (3 failed, 26528 passed, 32 skipped, 2 xfailed of 26618 unique test-call records). The crash is orthogonal to the #3283 bootstrap-hang risk this run deliberately routed around (tests/review, tests/runtime excluded up front); durations for every test that completed before the crash were still flushed and are included.

partial_probe.description: Bounded 90s probe of tests/review + tests/runtime together (same plugin), to confirm/characterize the #3283 hang rather than assume it. Confirmed: the run reached ~95% before hanging (exit 124/timeout). Partial durations captured before the hang are folded into module_test_durations below for the 'review', 'next', and 'execution_context' modules (whose test dirs include tests/review/tests/runtime) as the best available signal -- balancing for those modules is against incomplete data, flagged here.

unmapped_tests.description: Tests whose path does not fall under any of the 19 module registry test-directory globs (e.g. tests/integration, tests/auth, tests/tracker, ...) -- these belong to no src-backed WP05 scrub group (the module registry only covers src/** modules; docs/corpus/e2e are non-src router groups per the scrub, out of this registry's scope). (Updated by #4334: tests/unit and tests/specify_cli/runtime are now mapped modules; the count moved 17 -> 19.)
